data.name: Brahmvir
data.gender_notes: Brahmvir is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Brahma’ (the supreme god) and ‘Vir’ (power), Brahmvir signifies the divine power and supremacy of the almighty Brahma. The name Brahmvir carries the meaning “Brahma's power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Brahmvir usually hope their child will grow to embody brahma's power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrying the divine energy of the creator, Brahmvir inspires courage, wisdom, and devotion.
data.etymology: Brahmvir belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brahma's power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brahmvir total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

For Hindus, Brahmvir embodies the cosmic strength, intelligence, and wisdom that helps in shaping the universe and life itself.
